title: Exact conservative component restriction on a total simplicial site
statement: Let $\mathcal C_\bullet$ be a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] in small sites and morphisms of sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention]: for $\varphi:[m]\to[n]$ a morphism of sites $f_\varphi:\mathcal C_n\to\mathcal C_m$; the identity and composition laws may hold through specified isomorphisms $f_{\psi}^{-1}f_\varphi^{-1}\cong f_{\varphi\circ\psi}^{-1}$, $f_{\mathrm{id}}^{-1}\cong\mathrm{id}$ satisfying the cocycle identities (equalities in the strict case). Let $\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C_{total})$ be the category of systems $(F_n,F(\varphi))$ of sheaves $F_n$ on $\mathcal C_n$ and maps $F(\varphi):f_\varphi^{-1}F_m\to F_n$ compatible with identities and composition through these isomorphisms (in the strict case the sheaves on the total site), and $\mathrm{Ab}(\mathcal C_{total})$ the analogous category of systems of abelian sheaves. For each $n$ let $r_n:\mathrm{Ab}(\mathcal C_{total})\to\mathrm{Ab}(\mathcal C_n)$, $(F_k,F(\varphi))\mapsto F_n$. Then $r_n$ has an exact left adjoint $g_{n!}$, whose value on an abelian sheaf $G$ on $\mathcal C_n$ has degree-$m$ component $\bigoplus_{\varphi:[n]\to[m]}f_\varphi^{-1}G$ with transition maps induced by the composition isomorphisms. Consequently each $r_n$ is exact, sends injective abelian sheaves [def-sp-injective-resolutions] to injective abelian sheaves and K-injective complexes to K-injective complexes, and the family $(r_n)_n$ is conservative.
